about.author: @Kaiconure
description: Standard idler role that just sits in place, using XP/CP rings and common consumables.
Great for being power leveled in a safe spot.

idle.comment: Uses the appropriate XP or CP rings based on current level and mastery.
Uses common usable item drops, such as silt and bead pouches, and UNM coffers (work in progress).

mounted.comment: Follows the party leader while mounted. Does nothing if you are the party leader.
